tiers.deep: one exact composition covers every board-present capability with compiled ownership and lifecycle witnesses; hardware-inapplicable capabilities are explicit and applicable gaps are empty
tiers.constrained: an Arduino-first exact composition exposes an honest bounded subset while at least one board-present capability remains upstream-owned or lifecycle-incomplete
tiers.provider: one or more native portable provider traits are implemented, but the exact board still has applicable capability gaps
tiers.core: target startup and status path available; portable peripheral providers are incomplete

evidence_kinds.host-test: executable host-side contract or state-machine test
evidence_kinds.target-build: successful compilation for the declared target; not physical behavior

maturities.implemented: the declared surface is present and has the cited non-physical evidence
maturities.experimental: the declared surface is usable but may change incompatibly

nrf52840.limitations: Both exact native boot layouts retain their verified timer/event/DMA/servo/bus/USB/lease providers. GPIO, general IRQ, UART/byte I/O, ADC, general PWM/pulse, watchdog, RTC, application flash, reset, and power lifecycle providers remain applicable gaps, so neither composition is deep HAL.

rp2040.limitations: W114 provides the exact target-built native provider contract and shared lifecycle adapters; watchdog, RTC, flash, cache, and a first-class pulse provider remain applicable gaps. W115 physical Pico PIO/DMA/bus/radio/USB evidence remains valid but does not establish full-board parity.

rp2350.limitations: W114 provides the exact target-built native provider contract, shared lifecycle adapters, and exact-one CYW43439 backend selection; watchdog, retained-time/RTC, flash, cache, and a first-class pulse provider remain applicable gaps. W115 physical Pico 2 W PIO/DMA/bus/radio/USB evidence remains valid but does not establish full-board parity.

esp32.limitations: The native composition preserves sparse and input-only GPIOs, split SPI/I2S PDMA domains, dual-core ownership, and the external UART bridge without claiming native USB. Watchdog, retained-time/RTC, and application flash remain applicable gaps. Radio lifecycle remains independently selected through the Arduino Bluedroid composition.

camera_parallel.limitations: Exact only for the AI-Thinker ESP32-CAM OV2640 composition; resource price and live sensor disconnect remain unmeasured.

ble_link.limitations: The pinned Arduino-ESP32 3.3.10 package selects Bluedroid. Two independent eight-cycle state-restoring campaigns cover GATT read/write/notify, recovery, and concurrent WiFi DNS/TCP traffic; the published price covers that whole composition rather than an unevidenced BLE-only increment.

wifi_link.limitations: The pinned Arduino-ESP32 3.3.10 facade and two state-restoring campaigns cover association, DNS, TCP, lifecycle, and Bluedroid coexistence. The campaign priced the whole combined composition, so a separate wifi0 increment remains explicitly unmeasured.

esp32c3.limitations: The native provider composition has exact C3 silicon bounds, target-compiled providers, host lifecycle/ownership tests, and USB Serial/JTAG state-machine coverage. Watchdog, retained-time/RTC, and flash remain applicable gaps; the single-core C3 declares multicore hardware-inapplicable.

adc_dma.limitations: The exact persistent-buffer binding is configuration-specific; calibrated accuracy remains unverified.

ble_link.limitations: The pinned Arduino-ESP32 3.3.10 package selects NimBLE. Three state-restoring physical cycles cover GATT read/write/notify and recovery during admitted WiFi DNS/TCP traffic; the price is scoped to that exact four-operations-per-second composition.

wifi_link.limitations: One exact pinned Arduino-ESP32 C3 station composition is configuration-priced at four HTTP transactions per second and has state-restoring association/DNS/TCP/lifecycle evidence, including the separately priced NimBLE ble0 coexistence workload. Other workloads and boards remain unverified.

esp32p4.limitations: The exact P4-Pico native composition separates two symmetric HP application cores from the LP-core image, preserves AHB-GDMA/AXI-GDMA/VDMA domains, and distinguishes integrated USB Serial/JTAG plus FS/HS OTG from the external CH343 UART bridge. Native pulse, watchdog, retained-time/RTC, and application flash remain applicable gaps; the optional CSI data plane remains separately unclaimed.

adc_dma.limitations: The exact binding uses a DMA-aligned 32-conversion frame; calibrated accuracy remains unverified.

esp32s3.limitations: The native provider composition has exact sparse-GPIO and directional-RMT bounds, target-compiled providers, host lifecycle/ownership tests, and USB Serial/JTAG state-machine coverage. Watchdog, retained-time/RTC, and flash remain applicable gaps. Arduino audio/camera/wireless compositions remain independently mounted and priced.

adc_dma.limitations: Exact only for one ADC1 channel, 12-bit calibrated output, 16 conversions per frame, 20 ksample/s, and 1250 reads per second. Absolute input accuracy remains unverified.

audio_i2s.limitations: Exact only for 16 kHz mono signed-16 full-duplex ES8311 audio with 192-byte frames, two queue slots, and 100 transfers per second.

camera_parallel.limitations: Exact XIAO OV3660 and ESP32-S3-CAM OV5640 profiles are independently mounted and physically restored; resource prices and live sensor disconnect remain unmeasured.

ble_link.limitations: The pinned Arduino-ESP32 3.3.10 package selects NimBLE; only the bounded facade, target build, and zero-disabled state are evidenced.

ra4m1.limitations: Native Rust provides a LOCO-clocked AGT timebase/deadline, GPT2/ELC event capture, opt-in GPT/ELC/DMAC completion, bounded ADC/PWM/I2C/SPI/UART, USBFS, reset, CPU sleep, and generation-safe leases. General GPIO/IRQ, pulse capture, watchdog, RTC, and application flash remain applicable gaps; current physical evidence for the implemented subset remains valid.

ble_link.limitations: Exact UNO R4/ArduinoBLE 2.1.0/controller 0.6.0 physical evidence covers GATT write/read/notify, provider disconnect, remount/recovery, and a subscribed BLE link across WiFiS3 DNS/TCP traffic. Controller flash/static RAM and minimum task/stack evidence are pinned; retained/transient heap, complete task/stack reservations, CPU, and the complete shared-controller price remain unmeasured.

wifi_link.limitations: One exact UNO R4/WiFiS3 0.6.0 workload has zero-disabled, physical association/DNS/TCP/lifecycle, and RA-side/controller-image pricing. Controller-internal runtime resources, BLE coexistence, other firmware versions, and other workloads remain separate.

samd21.limitations: The exact Arduino Zero-compatible native composition is host-tested and target-built; RTC/TC4, EIC/EVSYS/DMAC, TCC PWM, SERCOM UART/I2C/SPI, USB CDC, reset, CPU sleep, and generation-safe leases are implemented. ADC, pulse capture, watchdog, and application flash remain applicable gaps, so the row is a native provider rather than deep HAL.

esp8266.limitations: The exact D1 Mini composition is Arduino-first and single-core. Native USB, multicore, and memory isolation are hardware-inapplicable. No bounded DMA ownership provider is admitted. GPIO6-11 remain flash-owned, GPIO16 has no normal external IRQ, PWM is software-scheduled, ADC is A0-only, deep sleep is reset-style with external wake wiring, and the vendor WiFi/lwIP stack owns process-wide heap and callbacks.

atmega328p.limitations: The exact Nano V3 composition is cooperative and single-core. Native USB, multicore, memory isolation, and DMA are hardware-inapplicable. SRAM is 2 KiB; the admitted application envelope is four tasks/four wires with a 1 KiB application budget. PWM is timer-shared, ADC is 10-bit, I2C is bounded by the 32-byte Wire buffer, and idle sleep depends on enabled interrupt wake sources. Reset is application re-entry only because watchdog hardware reset is unsafe with the exact old bootloader.
